description: Defines the IFirmwareDownload interface and related structures for firmware download management, including notifications, firmware info retrieval, and download status.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload
classes.description: Interface for managing firmware download processes, including notifications, status queries, and firmware info.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for firmware download events, such as firmware availability.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::FirmwareDownloadState
classes.description: Structure representing the current state of the download process.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::DownloadFailureReason
classes.description: Structure representing the reason for a download failure.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for firmware download events.

methods.name: GetDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current and downloaded firmware versions and location.

methods.name: GetFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Gets the current firmware download percentage.

methods.name: SearchFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a search for available firmware updates.

methods.name: GetDownloadState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the firmware download process.

methods.name: GetDownloadFailureReason
methods.description: Gets the reason for the last download failure.
